name: dots-mcp
description: Connect ChatGPT to the user's Dots Runtime for persistent goals with real-time MCP Events lifecycle updates.

interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, continue, and read results from persistent Dots goals. Persistent goals use MCP Events so important lifecycle updates can be delivered back to the originating ChatGPT conversation in real time.
defaultPrompt: Create a persistent Dots goal for this task and notify me here in real time when it completes, fails, is blocked, or needs approval.
Check the status of my Dots goal.
Continue an existing Dots goal and keep its real-time lifecycle subscription active.
